lines: 1. Annual Leave
All full-time employees are entitled to 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Leave must be requested at least 5 working days in advance through the HR portal.
Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried days expire on 31 March.
Part-time employees receive a pro rata entitlement based on their contracted hours.
2. Sick Leave and Family Leave
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
A medical certificate is required when sick leave lasts more than 3 consecutive days.
Employees must inform their manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence.
Maternity leave is 26 weeks on full pay. Paternity leave is 2 weeks on full pay.
Family leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption.
3. Work Arrangements
Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval.
Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 local time.
The company provides a one-time home office allowance of 300 USD.
Overtime must be approved in advance by the line manager.
Approved overtime is paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate on weekdays and 2 times on weekends.
4. Benefits
The company pays 100 percent of the health insurance premium for the employee and 50 percent for dependants.
Coverage starts on the first day of employment.
Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,000 USD for courses and conferences.
The company matches pension contributions up to 5 percent of salary.
5. Code of Conduct
Employees must treat colleagues with respect. Harassment and discrimination are not tolerated.
Violations must be reported to HR and are investigated within 10 working days.
Gifts worth more than 50 USD from suppliers must be declared to the manager.
Company laptops must not be used for private business.
6. Travel and Expenses
Business travel must be booked through the travel portal.
Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 150 USD per night.
Meals during travel are reimbursed up to 40 USD per day.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days using form HR-204.
7. Probation and Notice Period
The probation period is 6 months for all new employees.
The notice period is 1 month during probation and 3 months afterwards.
Employees who resign must return all company equipment on their last working day.
8. Performance and Pay
Performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and December.
Salary increases are decided once a year in January.
An employee rated needs improvement receives a 90 day improvement plan.
9. Contacts
For questions about leave or benefits, contact the HR helpdesk at hr-help@northwind.example.
The HR helpdesk phone number is +1 (555) 010-4477 and is open from 9:00 to 17:00.
Security incidents must be reported to security@northwind.example immediately.
10. Facilities
Employees may park free of charge in car park B during working hours.
Visitors must register at reception and may park in car park A.
